I already have a webhook ID for TV status

To have the TV tell Home Assistant what\'s on (the app, what\'s playing, the profile), put the ID of its Webhook automation here and the token can stay empty. Otherwise leave this closed: with an administrator\'s token, Hearth makes it for you.
